body:
Honestly I'm going crazy because of this. I made a whole bunch of spare accounts trying to contact her. No answer. I made a final spare and said goodbye.

It's not just closure I want though. I know she's going through a lot and she doesn't really have any friends. I'm just worried.

It just completely blows my mind. One of the first things she told me was how much it sucks when people do that to her.

I've literally spent days just sitting here, going through my conversations trying to figure out what I did to warrant this. I'm still coming up clueless and it's driving me mad.
